body:
Testing layers and evidence limits. task check runs module formatting, vet and tests, then negative type checks, the zero-dependency gate, reuse/task/doc checks, the promise gate and frozen Docsync validation. SQLite tests execute locally. PostgreSQL and MySQL integration tests skip without SQLB_PG_DSN and SQLB_MYSQL_DSN; PostgreSQL extension availability and server version add further gates. ClickHouse has render coverage here, not a live driver suite. A green default run therefore differs from verified server execution.
